Tractable Test

Testing Tractable to run GAMs on pyAFQ tractometry outputs with Elgan3 UMMS data

Load libraries

library(tractable)
Warning message:
R graphics engine version 16 is not supported by this version of RStudio. The Plots tab will be disabled until a newer version of RStudio is installed. 
library(dplyr)

Attaching package: ‘dplyr’

The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’:

    filter, lag

The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’:

    intersect, setdiff, setequal, union

Load data

afq<-read.csv("/Volumes/LaCie/Projects/elgan_dti/data/derivatives/afq/tract_profiles.csv")

elgan_demos<-read.csv("/Volumes/LaCie/Projects/BrainAge/data/elgan_demos.csv")

demos <- select(elgan_demos, c("subjectID", "sex", "female", "gadays", "bw", "AgeDecimal"))

dat<-left_join(afq,demos, by= "subjectID") 

#exclude poor quality datasets
dat<-dat %>% 
    filter(subjectID!="E1600662E") %>%
    filter(subjectID!="E1600881A")

Plot Profiles

plot_handles

$dti_fa

Fit GAMs by tract

CST

Make sure node group variable and subjectID are set as factors, else an error will occur



rcst_fit <- tractable_single_tract(
  df = dat,
  tract = "Right Corticospinal",
  target = "dti_fa",
  regressors = "sex",
  node_group = "sex",
  k = "auto"
)

rcst_summary <- summary(rcst_fit)
rcst_summary



lcst_fit <- tractable_single_tract(
  df = dat,
  tract = "Left Corticospinal",
  target = "dti_fa",
  regressors = "sex",
  node_group = "sex",
  k = "auto"
)

lcst_summary <- summary(lcst_fit)
lcst_summary
